units.source_text: 且说源氏对于二条院的尚侍胧月夜，至今还是不能忘情。

en.t: Now Genji still could not forget Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami of Nijo Palace.

units.source_text: 三公主出了那件可悲之事，他深感痛心，

en.t: After that sad affair befell the Third Princess, he was deeply grieved,

units.source_text: 于是对于这个意志薄弱的胧月夜也就略怀轻蔑之感了。

en.t: and so he came to feel a slight contempt for this weak-willed Oborozukiyo as well.

units.source_text: 后来闻知胧月夜已经成遂了出家的本愿，

en.t: Later, when he heard that Oborozukiyo had fulfilled her long-held wish to take religious vows,

units.source_text: 便又深感可怜，痛自后悔，立刻写信去慰问。

en.t: he again felt deep pity, bitterly regretted his feelings, and at once wrote to console her.

units.source_text: 信中严厉地责备她的无情：连最近出家也不通知他一声。

en.t: In the letter he harshly reproached her for her heartlessness, saying that she had not even sent him word of her recent renunciation.
